answer: Bind each seat to a physical GPU's thermal fingerprint: the agent runs one fixed compute kernel while on-die sensors log its power draw and the heat plume it sheds under sustained load. Silicon lottery means every card throttles on a slightly different DVFS curve, as identifiable as a lantern's own flicker. Clones sharing a card contend for it and emit a single correlated plume, collapsing to one seat; passing as N independents means owning N real GPUs, roughly $2,000 of hardware sunk per fake identity that no refunding or key churn can fake.
